overview.purpose: Add new Community Funds tab to admin interface for tracking community benefit wallet transactions

changes: Added new Community Funds tab button to navigation
Created comprehensive Community Funds tab content with wallet overview
Implemented transaction entry form with type, description, and amount fields
Added transaction history table with delete functionality
Integrated SOL balance display from community wallet

get_community_funds.functionality: Retrieve all community funds entries ordered by date

add_community_funds.functionality: Add new transaction entry with validation

delete_community_funds.functionality: Delete transaction entry by ID with confirmation

javascript_functions.loadCommunityFundsData: Main function to load both SOL balance and transaction entries
javascript_functions.loadSolBalance: Fetches SOL balance from community wallet using existing Helius API
javascript_functions.displayCommunityFundsEntries: Renders transaction table with delete buttons
javascript_functions.addCommunityFundsEntry: Handles form submission for new transactions
javascript_functions.refreshCommunityFundsData: Reloads all data for real-time updates

solana_integration.balance_retrieval: Uses existing get-nfts.php API endpoint with wallet address parameter
solana_integration.real_time_updates: SOL balance automatically refreshes when tab is loaded

wallet_overview.sol_balance_display: Large, prominent SOL balance with green styling
wallet_overview.wallet_address: Display of community wallet address for transparency
wallet_overview.refresh_button: Manual refresh option for balance updates

transaction_management.entry_form: Simple form with dropdown for transaction type, description field, and amount input
transaction_management.transaction_types: Predefined options: NFT Purchase, Prize Giveaway, Community Support, Other
transaction_management.validation: Client-side validation for required fields and positive amounts

transaction_history.table_view: Clean table showing date, type, description, amount, and delete action
transaction_history.sorting: Entries ordered by creation date (newest first)
transaction_history.delete_functionality: Individual delete buttons with confirmation dialogs

technical_architecture.frontend: HTML5 with Tailwind CSS styling, vanilla JavaScript for functionality
technical_architecture.backend: PHP 8+ with SQLite database, RESTful API design
technical_architecture.database: SQLite with prepared statements for security
technical_architecture.api_design: JSON-based communication with proper HTTP status codes
technical_architecture.error_handling: Comprehensive error handling with user-friendly messages

security_considerations.input_validation: Server-side validation of all input fields
security_considerations.sql_injection: Prepared statements prevent SQL injection attacks
security_considerations.access_control: Admin-only access through existing admin interface authentication
